download_visulogic_data: download VisuLogic benchmark data from HuggingFace and save prompts to a local directory
load_visulogic_prompts: load all VisuLogic prompts from the downloaded data directory into a lookup dictionary
download_visulogic_force: force re-download VisuLogic data from HuggingFace even if data already exists locally
review_download_function: review the download function that fetches data.jsonl and images.zip from the VisuLogic HuggingFace repo
review_load_prompts_function: review the load_prompts function that reads prompts.jsonl and returns a dictionary keyed by prompt id
